result: For separable intervention spaces with continuous observable-law maps, a countable dense intervention basis separates laws. For compact domains with a supplied Lipschitz/modulus bound, a finite covering-net certificate was implemented. The unrestricted uncountable discontinuous case was classified as admitting no countable separator. Focused tests: 6 passed.

next_leaf.problem: learn and independently validate a useful continuity modulus for intervention-to-observable-law discrepancy instead of assuming it
